AI will act as a silent partner in your ear or on a wearable device, instantly alerting you to a guest's historical preferences or specific allergy risks. You won't just be 'serving food'; you will be orchestrating a personalized social event. While machines can deliver plates, they cannot replicate the warmth of a welcome or the intuitive timing of a human server who knows exactly when a table needs privacy versus attention.
